proposed_facts.reason: State 0 selects anim_id -1; the shared changer removes animation, clears the script pointer, installs table callbacks and clears separate callbacks.
The unconditional picked-up transition and attachment-matrix callback support the corrected purpose.
Frame reset is unconditional, while command timer and loop-count resets occur only in the unselected descriptor branches.
Retraction completion calls the state-1 initializer with zero velocity, restores the cached fighter position, and always updates transforms.
Construction reads owner-derived scale rather than facing; normal completion records terminal x8 and first-created xC.
The simulation tests velocity before acceleration and advances next while calling collision processing on cur.
Threshold overshoot, collision correction, activation branches, early statuses and final damping match canonical control flow.
The solver leaves dist unchanged, upper-bounds len-dist without a lower clamp, and reports completion from prev; its consumer enters state 1.
UpdateAttachedYoyoMtx correctly describes the attachment-derived matrix written to the terminal yo-yo model, avoiding reversed topology.
The terminal model receives the scaled positive-Z attachment offset, uniform basis scale, matrix flags and dirty notification.
Construction and matrix-target selection establish that x8, not the first-created xC string segment, is transformed.
The state-0 wrapper and shared fighter controller support attachment presentation for the shared smash article.
State 0 delegates directly to the matrix-only helper without a local gameplay transition or timer.
Traversal begins at xC, follows prev, computes prev_pos-next_pos, overrides terminal direction and publishes the terminal position.
The move-specific nudge frame enters state 3 with one tenth of planar attachment distance; pointer-based completion enters state 1, not a guaranteed ten-tick return.
The initializer resets collision history and copies velocity, but the next state-1 update overwrites position and clears velocity; cited caller vectors are zero.

Source establishes table rows, vectors and arithmetic uses, not exact compiled sizes, contiguity or sdata/sdata2 coefficient placement. The distance is terminal position versus attachment-joint origin, not two stored link positions.
Accept supersession of all three picked-up descriptions: the selected -1 animation branch removes animation and clears the script pointer, without descriptor-branch timer resets.
Accept the retraction corrections: completion enters deployment state 1, the residual step has only an upper bound, and no fixed ten-tick duration follows from the initialization.

Accept the constructor input correction and all five attached-model corrections: owner scale is read, facing is not; x8 owns the terminal yo-yo model. Explicitly defer the inherited wrapper fact's residual first-string-link terminology rather than treating it as corroboration.
Accept both force-description corrections: pre-add comparisons are not strict post-add caps, and collision processing retains cur after advancing next.
Accept the transform-flow correction: xC is the first-created endpoint and direction subtraction is prev_pos-next_pos.
Accept the state-1 velocity correction: immediate initialization does not determine subsequent movement because state-1 simulation replaces position and zeros velocity.
